page_title: Code snippet organizer for pros | Cacher

sources.entry: Cacher - Cloud-based code snippet manager with Gist sync and multi-platform support.

summary.name: Cacher
summary.one_liner: Cacher is a code snippet manager for individuals and teams, with editor plugins, GitHub Gist sync, and a shared snippet library.
use_cases: Sharing code patterns across a team
Saving frequently used commands like grep
Creating and inserting snippets inside VSCode or IntelliJ
Building data visualization reports in Jupyter Notebook
summary.what_it_does: Cacher lets users create, label, and organize code snippets using color-coded labels by project, department, or priority. Plugins for VSCode, IntelliJ IDEs, and Raycast allow creating and inserting snippets without leaving the editor. Team snippets and labels sync automatically to each member's library regardless of platform or editor. Snippets support Markdown editing with live preview and file/image uploads, and can be synced with GitHub Gist after signing in with GitHub. An open-source command-line app is available for importing many snippets at once.
notable: Team snippets and labels sync automatically to every member's library
Sync with GitHub Gist on every update after GitHub sign-in
Public Snippets community pages with shareable URLs and embeds
caveats: Pricing tiers are not stated on the page
Editor integrations are limited to the plugins listed (VSCode, IntelliJ, Raycast)
